settings.playback.dts_passthrough.description: Playback preference title: send DTS audio unchanged to an external receiver.

settings.playback.dts_passthrough.copy.value: Send DTS soundtracks unchanged to an AV receiver or soundbar, which decodes them. On HDMI eARC/ARC, DTS-HD MA travels inside the TV's Dolby Digital Plus pass-through; otherwise, and on optical, DTS plays as its 5.1 core. Used only while the TV's sound goes to that output; set Digital Sound Output to Pass Through.
